candidates.title: Nvidia launches new open models to run agents in the enterprise and on PCs
candidates.summary: Nvidia is leaning hard into the trend of enterprise companies wanting to run their own open models in their own data centers and also trying to make on-device, private AI agents a thing.

candidates.title: Advancing coding in low‑resource programming languages
candidates.summary: Learn how OpenAI is improving ChatGPT across low-resource programming languages, with new evaluations for software engineering, SQLite, and COBOL migration.

candidates.title: Laplace Intelligence red-teams robots and self-driving cars before they hit the real world
candidates.summary: University of Michigan spinout Laplace Intelligence uses AI agents and interactive simulation to stress-test robots and self-driving vehicles before deployment. The profitable startup is competing in Startup Battlefield at TechCrunch Disrupt, October 13-15 in San Francisco.
